productId.description: Four-digit product code. Foreign key to products.id. Indexed, not unique: a coffee has many reviews.

userId.description: Reference to users._id for the account that wrote the review, or null for reviews not written by an account (the seed reviews in data/reviews.json). null rather than missing, like orders and quizResults.

name.description: Reviewer name shown on the review: the account's username when it was written, or the seed reviewer's name. Kept as written, like an order's item names.

rating.description: Whole stars only. int, not double, so a rating of 4.5 is rejected.

comment.description: Review body. The reviews page character counter should enforce the same 1000.

date.description: Calendar day the customer posted, YYYY-MM-DD in their own time zone (app.js localDateString). A string, not a BSON date, on purpose: see SCHEMA.md.
